name: Monitor Effluent Plant
implementation_notes: effluent_plant_record/effluent_plant_detail local SQLite tables added to localSchema.ts (CREATE_EFFLUENT_PLANT_RECORD/CREATE_EFFLUENT_PLANT_DETAIL, appended to CREATE_TABLE_STATEMENTS) -- mirrors process_water_record/process_water_detail's shape, following the hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row) pattern. UNLIKE Process Water, this station has NO identifying/context columns (no shift/inspector_id equivalent) -- all 19 non-time_slot columns are reading/status columns, including 3 enum status columns (biogas_flare_status, dosing_pump_1_status, sludge_dewatering_status) stored as plain TEXT locally (no CHECK constraint in SQLite local schema)

effluentPlantRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Effluent Plant screens (065/075/085) in one file, same convention as processWaterRecordRepo.ts covering screens 062/072/082; its full unit test coverage (effluentPlantRecordRepo.spec.ts, 30 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence

createDraft() inserts ONLY the header row -- effluent_plant_detail rows are added one at a time by the user in Form Effluent Plant via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring processWaterRecordRepo.ts's pattern
'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter is a plain COUNT(*) of effluent_plant_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no filled-row filter, mirrors Process Water's Monitor counter exactly

Router: route name 'monitor-effluent-plant' registered in router/index.ts -- StationListView.vue (screen-006) already had this route name pre-wired in MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES and an 'effluent-plant': false placeholder in draftStatusByType; this implementation wires the real effluentPlantRecordRepo.getDrafts() call into StationListView.vue's Promise.all, replacing that placeholder with effluentPlant.length > 0 -- same additive pattern Process Water used for this same pre-existing scaffolding

deferred_items.description: syncService.ts's syncAllRecords() was NOT extended with a syncEffluentPlantRecords() function (unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water, which each have one calling POST /api/effluent-plant-records via the mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button)
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Process Water) made the same deferral decision for the same reason. The web POST/PATCH routes are already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role) so wiring this up later requires no backend route change, only a syncService.ts addition.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-effluent-plant.spec.ts) was authored following the exact pattern of the other mobile station screens' e2e specs, but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment against a running dev server + seeded backend -- verified only by static review, not a live run.
